theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → Covector (Eucl P) m) (c : Covector (Eucl P) m) (w : NVector (Eucl P) m), Continuous f → (∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, c v = ∫ s in a..b, f s v) → ∫ s in a..b, w (f s) = w c
